parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Method 1 Fig. 1.1 shows an empty measuring cylinder on a balance and Fig. 1.2 shows the measuring cylinder containing water. Fig. 1.1 Fig. 1.2

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Read and record the mass m 1 of the empty measuring cylinder. m 1 = ................................................. g

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Read and record the mass m 2 of the measuring cylinder and water. m 2 = ................................................. g

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Read and record the volume V 1 of water, as shown in Fig. 1.2. V 1 = ............................................. cm 3

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate a value ρ 1 for the density of water using your readings from (a)(i) , (ii) and (iii) and the equation ρ 1 = m 2 – m 1 V 1 . Give an appropriate unit. ρ 1 = .................................................... [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Method 2 In this method, a test-tube is floated in the water left in the measuring cylinder from Method 1 and the change in water level is measured. Fig. 1.3 Fig. 1.4

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Read and record the mass m 3 of the test-tube, as shown in Fig. 1.3. m 3 = ....................................................

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The test-tube is carefully lowered, by means of a piece of cotton, into the measuring cylinder until it floats as shown in Fig. 1.4. Read and record the new water level V 2 in the measuring cylinder. V 2 = ....................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Using your results from (a)(iii) and (b)(ii) , calculate V 3 , the change in the water level, where V 3 = ( V 2 – V 1 ). V 3 = ....................................................

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate and record a value ρ 2 for the density of water using the equation ρ 2 = m 3 V 3 . ρ 2 = .................................................... [3]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Calculate an average value ρ AV for the density of water using your results from (a)(iv) and (b)(iv) . ρ AV = ............................................... [1]
